import cv2,numpy as np
from scipy.signal import find_peaks,peak_widths,periodogram
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
im=cv2.imread('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_opencv_base.png',cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
for name,(x0,y0,x1,y1) in [('A',(65,220,420,540)),('B',(65,350,400,660)),('C',(170,330,465,610))]:
 gray=im[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(float)
 yy,xx=np.indices(gray.shape,dtype=float);xx+=x0;yy+=y0
 print('REGION',name,'DIM',gray.shape,flush=True)
 for theta in [140,141,141.5,142,142.5,143,144]:
  a=np.radians(theta)
  normal=-np.sin(a)*xx+np.cos(a)*yy
  idx=np.floor(normal*4).astype(int)
  idx-=idx.min();n=int(idx.max()+1)
  counts=np.bincount(idx.ravel(),minlength=n)
  mean=np.bincount(idx.ravel(),weights=(255-gray).ravel(),minlength=n)/np.maximum(counts,1)
  resid=gaussian_filter1d(mean,2.4)-gaussian_filter1d(mean,72)
  valid=counts>=110
  resid[~valid]=-100000
  peaks,prop=find_peaks(resid,prominence=3.5,distance=25)
  peaks=peaks[(peaks>25)&(peaks<n-25)]
  dx=np.diff(peaks)/4
  widths=peak_widths(resid,peaks,rel_height=.5)[0]/4 if len(peaks) else np.array([])
  small=dx[(dx>5)&(dx<20)]
  print('THETA',theta,'NP',len(peaks),'median_gap',round(float(np.median(small)),3) if len(small) else None,'gaps',np.round(dx[:30],2).tolist(),'positions',np.round(peaks[:20]/4,2).tolist(),'WIDTH',round(float(np.median(widths)),2) if len(widths) else None,'MAXRESP',round(float(np.max(resid[peaks])),2) if len(peaks) else None,flush=True)
